item.title: REFUND
item.body:
Github Issues 不再解答问题，请直接到官方社区forum.trae.cn提问


Dear Trae Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to raise a serious concern regarding an unauthorized deduction of $10 USD from my account towards your Pro subscription.

To my surprise, this amount was auto-debited without any prior notification or visible auto-payment setup on my account or card profile. As a result, I was unable to cancel or opt out of this payment in time.

I would like to clarify that I do not wish to use Trae’s Pro features, and I had no intention of subscribing to any paid plan. This deduction appears to be non-transparent.

I kindly request an immediate refund of the $10 charged, and confirmation of the cancellation of any active subscription linked to my account.

Please treat this matter as urgent. Looking forward to your swift resolution and a confirmation email.

Thank you for your cooperation.

MY ID
7620374990257439760

Email: adriangloria1030@gmail.com
